note: Raw run records for the ED-001 holdout exposure of 2026-09-04. ED-001 is a holdout document; these runs breached holdout discipline and are retained as evidence, not as development material. They support the concurrency and cache figures recorded in protocol 2.5.1 and 2.5.2. See protocol.json holdout_discipline.ed_001_exposure.
registered_comparison_material_note: Not the per-run measurement_valid field. Every one of the 14 root records here carries measurement_valid true, because they were recorded under measured_mode; the interactive child carries false. This key is the separate batch-level fact: the batch breached holdout discipline, so none of it may enter a registered comparison whatever the per-run flag says. It is evidence of the exposure and the source of figures quoted elsewhere, and nothing more.
retention: Records carry identifiers, hashes, counters, timings and attempt telemetry only; no document text, provision text or model prose.
